messages:
olga: Hi team, opening my first stack of dependent PRs (small refactor -> feature) and want to follow the team's preferred flow. A few Qs: do we prefer a staged chain of draft PRs or one big feature PR? also branch prefixes?

ben: welcome! we prefer small, staged PRs when possible. Open the refactor as a prep PR (draft ok), then the behavior PR that depends on it. Link PRs with 'depends-on: #<pr>' in the description. Keeps reviews small.

tara: Branch naming: prep work -> prep/<you>/short, feature -> feature/<you>/short, fixes -> fix/<short>, hotfixes -> hotfix/<ticket>. Example: prep/olga/kv-refactor then feature/olga/kv-prefetch.

olga: good to know. for commits: interactive rebase + squash on merge or keep multiple commits?

ben: develop with many commits, but before merging either squash via GitHub or rebase to craft a single Conventional Commit. We enforce Conventional Commits in the changelog generator. CI also checks the final commit subject.

tara: Example commit header we use:

```
feat(runtime): add kv prefetch for short requests

Why: reduces p95 for small payloads. Tests: unit + smoke. Resolves #321
```

ci-bot: redwood-ci: started: lint, tests, typecheck for PR chain. See https://ci.redwood.ai/build/999

olga: any labels or templates I should add?

ben: Use labels: `needs-review`, `perf-review` (if touching hot paths), `docs-needed` (if user-visible). The PR template auto-adds a checklist; fill out How to test and Rollout.

tara: If a PR is dependent, mark the child PR as draft until the parent merges, or add 'depends-on' and ping reviewers explaining the dependency. For release backports target `release/<major>.<minor>.x` (eg release/1.4.x).

olga: CI fails locally sometimes. Best way to reduce CI flakiness runs?

ben: Run `pre-commit run --all-files`, `pytest tests/unit -q`, and quick linters: `ruff check .` plus `black .`. For perf patches run `python perf/run.py --quick`.

devex-bot: Tip: if you need an expedited perf review ping @tara and add label `perf-review` and include a 2-sentence summary + a perf microbenchmark snippet.

olga: post-merge regressions: revert or patch forward?

tara: Patch forward for small issues. If customer-facing or SLA impact, open a revert and notify eng-sre. For release branches open a hotfix branch and cherry-pick.

olga: thanks all  I'll open drafts for the prep PR and feature PR, link them, and ping @ben for review when ready.
